request.description: Production native pixel-art board obstacle for Dungeon Matcher. 64x64 transparent PNG. Crisp single-pixel near-black outline, broad connected flat cel-shaded clusters, upper-left light, no blur, no text, no tile or background. Warm brown woody material, restrained moss olive and brighter green leaves. Match reference pixel scale and woodland materials. ONE-HIT weak ROOT: a small low mound of three thick interwoven exposed tree roots, broad warm brown bark with a fresh pale broken twig at the top and two small moss patches. Rounded triangular root mass about 46px wide and 37px high, centered. Clearly woody root obstacle, not a box, stump creature or vines frame. No face, no glow.

request.action: The thin bramble stems quickly withdraw in reverse growth, curling back toward the edges and shrinking away until the last frame is completely empty transparency. No new objects, no background, fixed camera. Large transparent gaps remain between stems. This clip will play BACKWARDS to show vines rapidly spreading inward and unfurling to the exact original vine weave.

A sharp invisible strike snaps the thin bramble stems apart at the center; the cut vines recoil elastically outward, curled tips whip back toward all four edges, tiny leaf fragments flick away and vanish. Finish on empty transparency. Quick punchy impact then short settling recoil. No weapon, no gem, no solid green cloud, fixed camera. Keep large transparent gaps.

Green bramble vines visibly grow quickly inward from the four edges of the empty transparent square, stems curling and unfurling until they form the exact sparse vine weave shown in the final image. First frame empty, final frame all vines present. Fixed camera, keep transparent gaps, no background, no gem, no flash.
